Orb is a usage-based billing and metering platform. The REST API ingests timestamped usage events, models customers, plans, prices, items, and billable metrics, manages subscriptions, and automates invoicing, credit ledgers, coupons, alerts, and webhooks. All endpoints are served over HTTPS at https://api.withorb.com/v1 and authenticated with a Bearer API key.
